description: This file defines helper functions for UTF-8 string manipulation within the Opencart System.Helper namespace, including functions for string length, position, substring, and case conversions, utilizing mb_* PHP functions.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Returns the length of the given UTF-8 encoded string using mb_strlen.

methods.name: strpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the first occurrence of a substring within a string, using mb_strpos.

methods.name: strrpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the last occurrence of a substring within a string, using mb_strrpos.

methods.name: substr
methods.description: Returns a portion of the string, using mb_substr.

methods.name: strtoupper
methods.description: Converts the string to uppercase, using mb_strtoupper.

methods.name: strtolower
methods.description: Converts the string to lowercase, using mb_strtolower.
